newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares edge up, but restrained.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares edge up, but restrained.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Shares closed slightly firmer overall with the lack of any clear trend abroad restraining the local market, traders said. While the cash market was higher, futures were slightly down indicating uncertainty, traders said.
*"The direction of foreign markets remains uncertain and the Lisbon bourse cannot escape this lack of definition. Let's see how the market reacts to a possible rate cut tomorrow," said one trader.
*Most analysts predict that the Bank of Portugal will take advantage of favourable inflation numbers and the strength of the escudo to cut official rates on Friday.

*Sonae Investimentos rose 1.74 percent to 5,600 escudos with traders saying that the gains could be linked to the approach of the dividend payment. Sonae, whose shares have risen five percent since last Friday, will pay 150 escudos per share before tax.
*Portugal Telecom was also slightly firmer with the market awaiting news of which international alliance the company will opt to join.
*Most of the heavy business in Banco Comercial Portugues was comprised of a single block trade of 400,000 shares which appeared to be a passage from one investment fund to another, traders said.
